collegeEvents.title: HI-TECH Innovation & Applied AI Symposium 2026
collegeEvents.venue: Nairobi Main Campus — Innovation Auditorium & Live Stream
collegeEvents.requirements: Bring a student/national ID for campus check-in. Laptops optional for afternoon labs.
collegeEvents.targetAudience: College Students, Prospective Applicants, Industry Engineers & Educators
collegeEvents.fullDescription:
The HI-TECH Innovation & Applied AI Symposium brings together software architects, data scientists, government skills regulators, and HI-TECH College trainees for a full day of live technical demonstrations, research panels, and hands-on AI deployment clinics.

Participants will examine real-world Kenyan case studies in smart agribusiness, fintech infrastructure security, computer vision for manufacturing, and TVET digital curriculum modernization. Students presenting capstone prototypes will showcase projects directly to hiring industry partners.
collegeEvents.shortDescription: Flagship technology summit uniting industry engineers, AI researchers, TVET leaders, and students to explore practical automation, software engineering, and enterprise AI systems across East Africa.

collegeEvents.title: ICT & Cybersecurity Practical Career Clinic
collegeEvents.venue: Westlands Technology Park Campus — Cyber Range Lab 2
collegeEvents.requirements: Carry 2 printed copies of your CV or digital GitHub portfolio link.
collegeEvents.targetAudience: Diploma & Certificate ICT Trainees, Finalists & Tech Enthusiasts
collegeEvents.fullDescription: Hosted today by our ICT Infrastructure & Industry Placement team, this intensive career clinic equips learners and prospective technology students with CV clinics, defensive cybersecurity demonstrations, and direct interviews for upcoming industrial attachment slots.
collegeEvents.shortDescription: Live portfolio reviews, SOC analyst career pathways, networking lab walkthroughs, and internship placement interviews at Westlands Campus.

collegeEvents.title: Full-Stack Cloud & DevOps Practical Workshop
collegeEvents.venue: Nairobi Main Campus — Engineering Lab A1
collegeEvents.requirements: Basic familiarity with Linux terminal and Git. Lab workstations are provided.
collegeEvents.targetAudience: Software Developers, System Admins & Intermediate Computing Students
collegeEvents.fullDescription: Designed for ambitious developers and systems administrators, this practical workshop provides 6 hours of guided lab infrastructure deployment. Participants receive sandbox cloud environments, printed reference handbooks, and a verifiable HI-TECH College CPD workshop certificate upon completion.
collegeEvents.shortDescription: Hands-on weekend technical workshop covering Linux containers, PostgreSQL administration, automated CI/CD, and cloud observability.

collegeEvents.title: KNEC & CDACC Competency Assessment Readiness Webinar
collegeEvents.requirements: Stable internet connection and updated browser or mobile device.
collegeEvents.targetAudience: Current Trainees, Parents / Guardians & Prospective Applicants
collegeEvents.fullDescription: Join the Academic Registry and Examinations Office online for clear guidance on TVETA/CDACC modular assessment rubrics, KNEC candidate registration verification, academic progression rules, and industrial attachment logbook expectations.
collegeEvents.shortDescription: Interactive online seminar walking candidates, parents, and trainers through national CBET practical portfolios and exam registration timelines.

collegeEvents.title: May 2026 Campus Open Day & Admissions Expo
collegeEvents.venue: Nairobi Main Campus — Academic Towers & Quadrangle
collegeEvents.requirements: Bring academic result slips / certificates for instant eligibility assessment.
collegeEvents.targetAudience: KCSE Graduates, Parents, Career Teachers & Transfer Applicants
collegeEvents.fullDescription: Prospective diploma and certificate students, parents, and high school principals are invited to experience HI-TECH College firsthand. Explore our AI computing labs, engineering workshops, hostel accommodation options, and speak directly with Heads of Department about career trajectories.
